short: An American heavy strategic bomber featuring advanced stealth technology and a flying wing design.
full:
The Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit entered service with the United States Air Force on 1 January 1997. Conceived during the late Cold War to penetrate dense Soviet anti-aircraft defenses, it utilizes a highly distinctive flying wing configuration and advanced radar-absorbent materials to achieve an exceptionally low radar cross-section. It is capable of delivering both conventional and thermonuclear weapons globally.

Production of the B-2 was drastically curtailed from one hundred and thirty-two planned aircraft to just twenty-one following the collapse of the Soviet Union, making it the most expensive aircraft ever built. It first saw combat during the 1999 Kosovo War and has since been deployed in conflicts across the Middle East, remaining a central pillar of the American strategic nuclear deterrent.
